strings.zh: 听说枯叶市的观光游轮很豪华呢,{NEWLINE}好想坐一次看看啊！
strings.en: I hear the cruise ship in Vermilion City{NEWLINE}is really luxurious.{SCROLL}I’d love to ride it once!
strings.notes: Route 5 gate / Underground Path entrance NPCs.

strings.zh: 地下通道聚集了很多训练家,{NEWLINE}他们气势汹汹的样子,{CLEAR}简直让人不敢靠近。
strings.en: Lots of Trainers hang out in the{NEWLINE}Underground Path.{SCROLL}They look so fierce, I don’t dare go{NEWLINE}near them.
